title: A DVR keeps its normalized order after extending its residue field
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field, let k' be an extension field of k [def-pc-field-extension], and let (R, m) be a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] which is a k-algebra with residue-field identification R/m = k. Write K for the fraction field of R. Put R' = (R\otimes_k k')_{m(R\otimes_k k')} and let K' be the fraction field of the domain K\otimes_k k'. Then R' is a discrete valuation ring, the image of every uniformizer of R is a uniformizer of R', and for every nonzero f\in K the normalized exponent of f in R' equals its normalized exponent in R.
